rows.details: Baroda Swarojgar Vikas Sansthan (BSVS) / Bank of Baroda RSETI
Consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 - 2000x5 - Rs. 40,000/- per month
12 months (Renewable up to retirement age of 60 years or project period, subject to satisfactory performance)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted for a single post at the specified RSETI location.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Additional requirements for the Faculty post include: Shall have a flair for teaching and possess sound Computer Knowledge. Excellent communication skills in the local language essential, fluency in English and Hindi will be an added advantage. Skills in Typing in Local Language essential. Typing skills in Hindi/ English typing, an added advantage.

rows.qualification: Shall be a Graduate (any i.e., Science/Commerce/Arts) /Post-Graduate; preference may be given to MSW/MA in Rural Development/MA in Sociology/ Psychology/ B.Sc. (Veterinary), B.Sc. (Horticulture), B.Sc. (Agri.), B.Sc.( Agri. Marketing}/B.A. with B.Ed. etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 - 2000x5 - Rs. 40,000/- per month. An annual performance incentive of Rs. 2,000/- every year will be based on a satisfactory review and performance of services rendered. Additional allowances and terms include: Fixed Conveyance Allowance [FCA]: Rs. 2,500/- per month on a declaration basis, subject to completion of a minimum number of visits for conducting EAPs, Follow ups, etc. Otherwise, the Director of the RSETIs shall consider paying proportionately. Mobile allowance: Rs. 300/- per month. Statutory Benefits: EPF, ESI, and Gratuity as per rules. Tenure and Renewal: The contract is valid for 12 months. Increments accrued shall continue at the time of renewal of each contract period, and the contract may continue till the retirement age of 60 years or the project period whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and renewal of the contract period from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: The support staff for Faculty at RSETIs shall perform the following duties and responsibilities: Any other work assigned by the Director from time to time. Work as Faculty of the Institute handling sessions relating to entrepreneurship, motivation personality development, business management, conducting business games etc., guiding/educating the trainees and coordinating the programmes of the Institute. Conducting pre-training activities - EAPs, generation of applications and selection of candidates. Assisting the Director in designing the Annual Action Plan and training programmes. Arranging logistics for the training programmes, including training materials and arranging Guest faculty. Providing post Training escort services including conducting follow-up meets/visits. Providing counseling, credit linkage, preparation of project reports etc. Preparation of Success Stories and circulation of a minimum of two stories per month to the Controlling Office/MoRD. Preparation of Post Programme Report and monthly/periodical reports. Assisting/Guiding the Office assistant in maintaining of Day book, General Ledger and all other registers and Books. Design new training programs by collecting feedback on emerging business opportunities in the area. Prepare case studies and training materials for effective delivery of sessions and establish liaison with outside agencies. Assist Director in internal control/administration, organizing functions, events, and meetings of the Institute. Preparation of Press release/reports on various activities, supervising assistant, attender, watchman cum Gardner, and monitoring Guest faculty performance. Maintenance of Inventory and Library books, and overseeing the maintenance of the entire campus including classrooms, kitchen, dining, and dormitory to keep premises clean and tidy. Maintaining discipline in the Institute and ensuring administration of MILLY, LOG, PRAYER, YOGA, SHRAMADHAN etc., on daily basis.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria and Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Faculty post is 22 to 40 years as on 01.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will comprise three stages: Written Test: To assess General Knowledge and Computer capability. Personal Interview: To assess communication ability, leadership qualities, attitude, problem-solving ability, ability to get along with the trainees, and developmental approach. Demonstration/Presentation: To assess teaching skills and communication capability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Faculty
content_sections.text: Ensure fulfillment of eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in the guidelines. Prepare the application in the given format (Annexure C) along with self-attested copies of educational qualifications and other relevant supporting documents. Pack the hardcopy application inside an envelope and write the title on the envelope as: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF “FACULTY” at RSETI PANCHMAHAL (GODHRA) PURELY ON CONTRACTUAL BASIS. Send the completed application by post or submit it to the authorized address on or before 25.10.2026: The Authorized Person, Baroda Swarojgar Vikas Sansthan, Baroda –RSETI, Shivampark Society, Nr.Bank of Baroda Bamroli Road Branch, Godhra-389001, Dist-Panchmahal, Mob: 9099075899 .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled and signed application form in the format (Annexure C). Enclosures of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets. Other relevant supporting documents of experience and identity. Medical fitness report issued by any Government Hospital (required only for the selected candidate prior to joining).

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date (25.10.2026) or incomplete applications will be rejected. Application for more than one RSETI may be rejected. Only hardcopy submissions are valid. Merely fulfilling eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for the written test; BSVS reserves the right to shortlist candidates. Selected candidates must join within 15 days from the date of receiving the offer letter. Either party may discontinue the contract by giving one month's notice or equivalent salary in lieu thereof. The Trust reserves the right to terminate the contract without assigning reasons, subject to one month's notice or salary in lieu thereof.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Faculty post at RSETI Panchmahal (Godhra).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Bank of Baroda Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 22 to 40 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary for the Faculty position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 30,000 - 2000x5 - Rs. 40,000/- per month, along with fixed conveyance allowance and mobile allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate (Science/Commerce/Arts) or Post-Graduate, with preference given to MSW, MA in Rural Development/Sociology, Psychology, B.Sc. (Veterinary/Horticulture/Agri/Agri Marketing), or B.A. with B.Ed.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their duly filled and signed applications in hardcopy format along with educational and relevant documents to the designated RSETI address by post on or before 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, a Personal Interview, and a Demonstration/Presentation.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: This is a contractual appointment for an initial period of 12 months, renewable up to the retirement age of 60 years or the project period whichever is earlier, based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Duly filled and signed application form in the specified format along with enclosures of educational qualifications and other relevant documents in hardcopy.
